notes: hex = sRGB, per-channel clipped (matches Chromium on sRGB displays); hexGamutMapped = CSS Color 4 OKLCh chroma-reduction gamut mapping; both equal for in-gamut colors
colors with alpha are to be composited over whatever is beneath (they are NOT pre-blended)
oklch = [L 0-1, C, H deg] of the resolved color
Page body in apps/ui/app/layout.tsx uses `bg-sidebar font-sans text-foreground antialiased` (the site canvas is --sidebar; content surfaces use --background).
Light --destructive-foreground is red-700 in globals.css, but alert.mdx manual-install snippet says red-400 (button/badge/menu/field mdx say red-700). globals.css is treated as authoritative.
The host app maps coss `primary` to its own accent at runtime; coss own primary is neutral-800 (light) / neutral-100 (dark).

globals sets `--tw-shadow-color: #000` in @theme inline; it lands on :root only, and because Tailwind registers --tw-shadow-color with `inherits: false` it never reaches elements, so it has no visible effect. Shadows use each utility's own color fallback.

radius.innerPattern: Most bordered controls draw an inner ::before with radius calc(<outer radius> - 1px) (e.g. 9px for rounded-lg) carrying the 1px highlight shadow.

spacing.rule: Tailwind v4: <utility>-n = calc(var(--spacing) * n) = 4px × n (fractions allowed, e.g. 4.5 → 18px)

shadows.composition: Tailwind composes box-shadow = inset-shadow, inset-ring, ring-offset, ring, shadow (in that order). `shadow-X/N` replaces each layer color alpha with N%. `shadow-<color>/<a>` sets the shadow color (alpha multiplied). Rings: ring-N → 0 0 0 (N + offset)px ring-color; ring-offset-N → 0 0 0 Npx offset-color.

summary: Buttons / toggles / tabs / checkboxes / switches (focus-visible): `ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-1 ring-offset-background` → box-shadow `0 0 0 1px <background>, 0 0 0 3px <ring>` (1px gap in background color, then 2px ring). ring = neutral-400 #a1a1a1 light / neutral-500 #737373 dark.

Text inputs / textarea / select trigger / input-group (control has :focus-visible child): border-color → ring, plus `ring-[3px] ring-ring/24` → `0 0 0 3px` ring at 24% alpha, outer 1px highlight ::before shadow removed. Invalid+focus: border destructive/64, ring destructive/16 (dark /24).
Global default outline color (any element): outline-ring/50 (ring at 50%), but nearly all components set outline-none and draw rings with box-shadow.

opacity.disabled: 64% (opacity-64 on disabled / data-disabled / has-disabled; most components)

defaults.note: Tailwind `transition-*` without duration/ease classes use these

fromGlobals: @keyframes toast-error-odd { 0% { translate: 0 0; } 25% { translate: -3px 0; } 50% { translate: 3px 0; } 75% { translate: -3px 0; } 100% { translate: 0 0; } }
@keyframes toast-error-even { 0% { translate: 0 0; } 25% { translate: -3px 0; } 50% { translate: 3px 0; } 75% { translate: -3px 0; } 100% { translate: 0 0; } }
fromTailwindDefault: @keyframes bounce { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-25%); animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 1, 1); } 50% { transform: none; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } }

motion.reducedMotion: globals: toast feedback animations disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; many components gate transforms with motion-safe:/motion-reduce: (see enterExit).
motion.baseUiMechanics: Base UI sets data-starting-style on mount (one frame) and data-ending-style while unmounting, waiting for transitions/animations to finish. A native implementation should animate from the starting-style values to the default values on open and from default to ending-style values on close, using the part's transition-property/duration/easing.
